✧ tiny styling secrets

🎨 3-color magic
Choose one main color, one supporting shade and one neutral.
🎀 One statement detail
A bow, cute bag or charm can make the whole outfit feel intentional.
🧸 Play with shape
Try an oversized top with a structured bottom, or the reverse, if you like that silhouette.
💗 Comfort is cute
Adapt every look to your body, your budget, the weather and your day.
